title: Girls in Their Married Bliss
author: Edna O'Brien
current_text: Girls in Their Married Bliss was banned in the Republic of Ireland on publication in 1964. Girls in Their Married Bliss was also denounced and burnt in the mid-1960s for its frank descriptions of sex and sin.

sources.quote: O’Brien’s first three novels The Country Girls (1960), Girl with Green Eyes (1962) and Girls in their Married Bliss (1964) – which came to form her Country Girls trilogy – were all banned in the Republic of Ireland on publication.

Later additions to the trilogy, "The Lonely Girl" and "Girls in Their Married Bliss," would also cause an uproar in the mid-1960s as they were denounced, censored, and burnt for their frank descriptions of sex and sin.
sources.title: Edna O'Brien's "The Country Girls" trilogy, Dublin One Book | IrishCentral.com
